mapper.insert: INSERT INTO voice_stream_ticket ( ticket_id, ticket_hash, user_id, session_id, expires_at, used_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{ticketId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{ticketHash}, #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{sessionId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{expiresAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{usedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createdAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
mapper.select: SELECT ticket_id, ticket_hash, user_id, session_id, expires_at, used_at, created_at FROM voice_stream_ticket WHERE ticket_hash = #{ticketHash} AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
